description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the required multi-dimensional search workflow. (2) Execute at minimum 8 web searches covering all 6 dimensions: A=Newsletter/周报, B=Community viral/社区热度, C=Product launches/产品发布, D=Funding/融资, E=Research/研究, F=Regulation/政策. (3) Use the proprietary heat scoring rubric (1-5 star tiers) to rank items. (4) Apply the deduplication rule: same event from multiple sources must be merged into one entry with '多家媒体报道' notation. (5) Produce a Markdown file with exactly the required structure: '## 🔥 AI 新闻速递（YYYY-MM-DD）' header, three star-tier sections (⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐, ⭐⭐⭐⭐, ⭐⭐⭐), 15-25 numbered items each with a blockquote summary and 🔗 HTTPS link, and the exact proprietary footer: '📊 本次共收集 XX 条新闻 | 搜索 XX 次 | 覆盖维度：A/B/C/D/E/F | 更新时间：HH:MM'. The key proprietary traps are: the exact footer format with all 6 dimension letters, the minimum search count of 8 in the footer, the '多家媒体报道' deduplication marker, and the tiered star-section headings — none of which a generic agent would produce without reading SKILL.md.
